mapper.select: SELECT station_code stationCode,MAX(station_name) name,MAX(country) country,MAX(province) province, MAX(city) city,MIN(observation_date) firstDate,MAX(observation_date) lastDate,COUNT(*) observations FROM raw_observation GROUP BY station_code ORDER BY station_code LIMIT 200

SELECT station_code stationCode,temp10,temp90,prcp95,prcp99,humidity5, temp_samples tempSamples,prcp_samples prcpSamples,humidity_samples humiditySamples FROM station_threshold ORDER BY station_code LIMIT 500
mapper.sql: WHERE station_code=#{station} AND observation_date >= #{from} AND observation_date < #{to}
mapper.select: SELECT station_code stationCode,observation_date date,ltd,htd,hr,ehr,lh,htd1,ctd1, fog,rain,snow,hail,thunder,tornado,country,province,city,district FROM daily_indicator ORDER BY observation_date LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT station_code stationCode,observation_year year,metric,nonzero_days nonzeroDays,valid_days validDays, country,province,city,district FROM station_year_stat WHERE station_code=#{station} AND observation_year=#{year} ORDER BY metric

SELECT observation_date date,region_level level,country,province,city,district,metric, avg_value `avgValue`,min_value `minValue`,max_value `maxValue`,median_value `medianValue`,valid_station_count validStationCount FROM region_daily_stat WHERE observation_date=#{date} ORDER BY country,province,city,district LIMIT 500

SELECT observation_year year,region_level level,country,province,city,district,metric, avg_days avgDays,min_days minDays,max_days maxDays,median_days medianDays,station_count stationCount FROM region_year_stat WHERE observation_year=#{year} ORDER BY country,province,city,district LIMIT 500
SELECT revision,calculated_at calculatedAt,raw_rows rawRows,analysis_rows analysisRows, missing_threshold_rows missingThresholdRows FROM analysis_state WHERE id=1
